title: The Drowned Beacon
premise: For three hundred years the beacon at Tallow Point kept the Kestrel Coast safe. Then came the Black Tide: the great lamp went dark, a hungry fog rolled in, and ships began to founder on the Gullgrave rocks. A choir of cultists known as the Hollow Choir sings the fog onward, and someone powerful is paying for the wrecks. The party is hired to find out who, and to light the beacon again.

acts.title: Fog on the Quay
acts.goal: Learn who is dousing the lamps of Gullmere Quay and break the smugglers who serve the Choir.

region.name: Gullmere Quay
region.flavour: A rain-dark fishing harbour of tarred boats and shuttered windows, where the lamps keep going out.

arrival.name: Gullmere Quay
arrival.flavour: Wet cobbles, a harbourmaster's office with one lit window, and a tavern that still has a fire.

spokes.name: Rotting Boathouse
spokes.flavour: A collapsed boathouse on stilts, its floor boards slick with weed and its rafters full of rustling.

spokes.name: Saltcellar Tunnels
spokes.flavour: Old salt-merchants' tunnels under the quay, dripping and cold, with scratch marks on the walls.

spokes.name: Heron Marsh Causeway
spokes.flavour: A raised path of black planks across the reeds, with lantern-light blinking far out in the mist.

gateway.name: The Sunken Vestry
gateway.flavour: A drowned chapel half-sunk in the mud, where a low humming rises from beneath the floor.

boss.name: Gorran Hookhand
boss.ally_path: Show Gorran the Choir's tide-orders, which prove the Choir means to leave his crew to drown on the next tide; he turns on his masters and opens the vestry's hidden stair.

steps.text: Find the Choir's tide-orders in the Saltcellar Tunnels

acts.title: The Kelpglass Reach
acts.goal: Follow the Choir inland, win the old wardens' trust, and silence the Cantor who sings the fog.

region.name: The Kelpglass Reach
region.flavour: A salt-bitten stretch of wood and ruin along the coast road, where the fog lies thickest and old watch-fires still smoulder.

arrival.name: Lamplighters' Rest
arrival.flavour: A fortified waystation where the last honest lamplighters keep a stove going and a ledger of the lost.

spokes.name: Thornwood Shrine
spokes.flavour: A mossy shrine to the old tide-wardens, circled by thorn and the tracks of something heavy.

spokes.name: The Salt Barrow
spokes.flavour: A burial mound crusted in white salt, its door ajar and its air thick with the smell of old brine.

spokes.name: Harrowmere Bridge
spokes.flavour: A stone bridge over a fogbound gorge, with a toll-gate nobody asked for.

gateway.name: The Fogwright's Tower
gateway.flavour: A leaning tower of pale stone whose upper windows breathe out a slow grey mist, and a chorus of voices in the stairwell.

boss.name: Cantor Ashmere Voll
boss.ally_path: Bring the Cantor the drowned hymnal from the Salt Barrow; its last verse reminds him of the warden he was, and he lays the fog-song down.

routes.title: Remind the Cantor who he was

steps.text: Recover the drowned hymnal from the Salt Barrow
Bring the hymnal to Cantor Ashmere Voll
Scatter the Choir's watch on Harrowmere Bridge
Learn the tower's back stair from Old Marek Thistlewood

acts.title: The Dark Lantern
acts.goal: Climb Tallow Point, break the Magister's wards, and relight the beacon.

region.name: Tallow Point
region.flavour: A black headland of wind and gull-cry, crowned by a lighthouse whose lamp has been dark for a hundred nights.

arrival.name: Beacon Stair Landing
arrival.flavour: The foot of the great spiral stair, sheltered from the wind by a ring of old braziers.

spokes.name: Cistern of Echoes
spokes.flavour: A vast flooded cistern under the headland where every sound comes back as a whisper.

spokes.name: Keeper's Barracks
spokes.flavour: The keepers' quarters, frozen as if abandoned mid-meal, with one bunk still warm.

spokes.name: Wreckers' Gallery
spokes.flavour: An open gallery cut into the cliff, hung with salvaged figureheads and the nests of something large.

gateway.name: The Dark Lantern Room
gateway.flavour: The lamp chamber at the top of the stair: a vast dead lens ringed by chalked wards, and a man who has been waiting.

boss.name: Magister Orsolo Venk
boss.ally_path: Give Venk the salt-stained letter of his drowned daughter from the Cistern of Echoes; grief breaks his pact and he snuffs the dark lantern himself.

steps.text: Find the salt-stained letter in the Cistern of Echoes
Give the letter to Magister Orsolo Venk

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Odalys Prend
npcs.motive: Keep the quay alive and the Choir's smugglers off her docks without losing her post.

secrets.text: Odalys owes the Choir's smugglers a heavy debt and short-changed the lamplighters' oil to pay it.

npcs.name: Tobin Marrow
npcs.motive: Keep the Gull and Anchor open and avoid being noticed by the Choir.

secrets.text: Tobin saw lanterns moving out on the marsh the night the beacon died and kept quiet out of fear.

npcs.name: Sister Wren Calloway
npcs.motive: Atone for the years she sang with the Choir without knowing what the song was for.

secrets.text: The vestry door opens to a four-note hum, each note lower than the last.

npcs.name: Old Marek Thistlewood
npcs.motive: Keep the old tide-wardens' shrine from being looted and see the coast healed.

secrets.text: The third niche in the Salt Barrow hides the old warden's signet that wards against the fog.

npcs.name: Hesper Voss
npcs.motive: Keep her lamplighters alive and the road lit.

secrets.text: Fenwick Dray bought passage to the Point the day before the beacon failed.
Hesper keeps a wrecker's brass whistle and once signalled false lights for coin.

npcs.name: Fenwick Dray
npcs.motive: Reach the beacon's lamp first and sell its lens to the highest bidder.

secrets.text: Fenwick was paid by Magister Venk to guide wreckers to the Point, and he regrets it.

npcs.name: Warden Alder Quill
npcs.motive: See the beacon lit again before the last keeper's oath is broken.

secrets.text: The lens relights only if turned by hand against the sea wind; the Magister's wards fail to the keeper's key.

npcs.name: Dessa Orrin
npcs.motive: Sell lamp oil and rope to anyone still brave enough to buy, and keep her stall out of the Choir's way.

npcs.name: Corvin Tallowby
npcs.motive: Move his wagons of salvage and sundries through the fog and turn a fair profit on a hard season.

npcs.name: Imre Saltwick
npcs.motive: Keep the stair garrison supplied and the last lamps fed, whatever the cost.

quests.title: The Missing Ledger
quests.objective: Recover the harbour ledger the smugglers stole from the Gull and Anchor's cellar.

steps.text: Drive the smugglers out of the Saltcellar Tunnels

quests.title: Break the Smugglers
quests.objective: Break the smugglers' watch on the Heron Marsh Causeway that keeps the quay lamps dark.

steps.text: Break the smugglers' watch on the Heron Marsh Causeway

quests.title: The Warden's Signet
quests.objective: Recover the warden's signet from the Salt Barrow.

steps.text: Clear the Salt Barrow of its restless dead

quests.title: Kindle the Stair
quests.objective: Gather the three ember-stones that relight the braziers of the beacon stair.

steps.text: Gather the three ember-stones of the beacon stair
Bring the ember-stones to Warden Alder Quill

rival.hook: Fenwick keeps one step ahead of the party and may be bought, beaten, or befriended.

finale.question: The beacon is lit and the fog-song falters. Silence the Hollow Choir forever, or let its last verse be sung?

options.title: Silence the song
options.text: Break the Choir's last hymn; the coast is safe, and the old wardens' memory dies with it.

options.title: Let the last verse be sung
options.text: Let the song end on its own; the drowned are remembered, and the fog may one day return.
